digest.component_or_area: CI workflows - tickets repository fetch optimization
propositions: Apply --filter=blob:none to all CI tickets-branch fetch paths in reconcile-bridge.yml, verify-identity.yml, reconcile-bridge-canary.yml, and gerrit-verify.yaml to reduce transfer cost (measured: 1.04 GiB/59s→68.7 MiB/14.3s standalone; 6.73 min→3.6–8.6s Gerrit).

Verify actual Git protocol negotiation and missing-object behavior by running git daemon with filter capability advertising and validating client-to-server filter packets and known-blob absence for named-remote inheritance and direct-URL fetches.

Implement production pack-size guards that parse git count-objects -v output and reject packs exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 (standalone) and REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072 (Gerrit post-materialization).
Snapshot exact git count-objects -v before and after verify-identity materialization and fail if any object count changes, ensuring no promisor-object pollution during identity scanning.
Preserve existing fetch-depth: 0, credential/ref inputs, and depth semantics (--depth=1 for require-ticket, no depth for full-history identity fetch) while adding blob:none filter.
